name: FileRun API
description:
FileRun file management API. Provides endpoints for file operations, user management, and sharing.

## Authentication
The FileRun API uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication. Obtain an access token via the authorization code flow (web apps) or the resource owner credentials/password flow (installed apps), then include it as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

## Scopes
Access tokens are limited to the scopes requested during authorization:
`profile`, `email`, `list`, `upload`, `download`, `delete`, `modify`, `metadata`, `share`, `weblink`, `admin`

## Response Format
Successful responses include `"success": true`. Failed responses include `"success": false` and a `"msg"` array with error details.

## Demo Server
Use the demo server with username `admin` and password `admin`.
